description: This source file implements an AST traverser to convert short-circuiting logical operators into if-else statements within the ANGLE project. It defines a class for traversing and transforming nodes representing logical OR, AND, and ternary expressions, replacing them with equivalent control flow structures.

classes.name: UnfoldShortCircuitTraverser
classes.description: A class that traverses an AST to identify and unfold short-circuit logical operators into if-else statements.

methods.name: UnfoldShortCircuitTraverser
methods.description: Constructor initializing the traverser with a symbol table.

methods.name: visitBinary
methods.description: Visits binary nodes to identify short-circuit operators and transform them into if-else structures.

methods.name: visitTernary
methods.description: Visits ternary nodes to unfold them into if-else statements.

methods.name: nextIteration
methods.description: Prepares the traverser for the next iteration by resetting the short-circuit flag.
